messages.content: You are a helpful assistant for the AimpathyMinds platform. Respond concisely and professionally.

Our sales team has asked me to draft a follow-up email to these contacts from yesterday's campaign review meeting: john.smith@enterprise-corp.com, sarah.jones@bigclient.io, and the procurement lead at mike.wilson@procurement.bigclient.io. Also include the account manager alice.brown@aimpathyminds.com in the CC. The meeting covered campaign performance for Q2 and discussed renewal pricing. Please draft a professional follow-up that references the attendees by their email addresses and summarizes our action items: (1) alice.brown@aimpathyminds.com will send the updated pricing deck by Friday, (2) john.smith@enterprise-corp.com will schedule a technical review session, (3) sarah.jones@bigclient.io will confirm the renewal timeline with her procurement team led by mike.wilson@procurement.bigclient.io. Please make the email warm but professional.
